quotes.author: Makena C
quotes.text: We were on the Winona Sailboat with Capt Brandon, Capt Keone, Carl, Rachel & Canli and it was truly the most perfect setup. There were roughly 15 or so other people on the boat with us, plenty of room to move around and absolutely fabulous views. The crew could not have been more welcoming, attentive & genuinely enjoyable to be around. I would 100% do that again & recommend to anyone visiting Maui.

quotes.author: Amber M
quotes.text: We had an absolute blast! Great experience snorkeling and the Captain was great at finding so many whales. One even swam under the boat. In addition to the Captain there were 2 crew members who were wonderful and attentive. They provide a tasty breakfast and lunch spread complete with non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages. I would definitely come again!

quotes.author: Ernest A
quotes.text: My son and I went on this trip and had a great time! Captain was very friendly nice and had good jokes, the staff was friendly very helpful way worth the price 3 hours is plenty of time the location where they take you is perfect plenty of turtles swimming near can’t say anything but great things about the whole experience

quotes.author: sunsetlife2023
quotes.text: I love watching the sunsets on Maui but this sail boat “Winona” was my best experience ever. The crew is amazing and the music was fantastic. I love it how they arrange everything to be right in front of the sunset and take photos of a lifetime. Can’t wait to do it again.

quotes.author: Canli M
quotes.text: Wow! What an amazing moment to watch humpback whales in a competition pod and we got to do it on the sailboat Winona. The Captain and crew were phenomenal in their attentiveness to us. I highly recommend sailing with this company

quotes.author: Corinne V
quotes.text: The Boat was huge with lots of room. Crew was super friendly and helpful. Capt. Keone kept us laughing and lead a smooth and comfortable sail. Best cruise I’ve been on since i can remember. Highly recommended!!
